claims.statement: Tom Allen was to train Jem Mace four miles from St. Louis and back him for a sum printed as 200 against Ned O'Baldwin.
claims.excerpt: Tom Alien will train Mace at the Wasa coene four mules from this city, and back him for

notes: Dispatch datelined St. Louis, June 30. The place is printed as Wasa coene and the sum as 200 (hint says $2,000; not confirmed by the text). The O'Baldwin challenge to Mace is not about Allen and is left out.
